in_arabic.name: Rasiyah
in_arabic.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'r-s-y', meaning 'to be satisfied' or 'content'. This name is a variant of Rasheeda, which is a popular Islamic name.

in_urdu.name: راسیہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: Raadi (راضی) in Urdu means 'satisfied' or 'content'. This name is derived from the Arabic root 'r-s-y', which has the same meaning.

in_hindi.name: रासिया
in_hindi.long_meaning: Puraa (पूरा) in Hindi means 'complete' or 'full'. This name is derived from the Arabic root 'r-s-y', which has the meaning 'to be satisfied' or 'content'. The name Rasiyah is a variant of Rasheeda, which is a popular Islamic name.

in_pashto.name: راسيه
in_pashto.long_meaning: Danishta (دانشته) in Pashto means 'learned' or 'educated'. While this meaning is different from the Arabic root 'r-s-y' meaning 'to be satisfied' or 'content', it is a valid interpretation of the name Rasiyah.
